summary: 3 MET, listed NOT MET by its wording. I reran every check myself at the PR head: setup.sh installed 4d11a54 into a fresh HOME (/home/user/vhome), and three claude -p sessions without --plugin-dir, in this cloud container on Claude Code 2.1.318, reproduced the builder's results (evidence/ here; verify/probe-plugin-agents/evidence.test.mjs checks both sets, 9 pass). The mechanism holds. But listed asks for 'a fresh cloud thread on the release that ships the agent', and neither exists: no release ships agents/probe-reader.md (the install is the build commit, tag null), and no Projects thread ran it, because fresh threads resume the cached 0.1.17 container until the person re-saves the setup script. Closing it needs either a replan that rewords listed to the path both sessions ran (setup.sh install of the build commit, claude -p in a cloud container, no --plugin-dir) and moves the real-thread check to the first thread after the re-save, or that re-save plus a release from this branch.
